name: companion-unit-ownership
goal: Automatically attach new companion type files to their implementation unit without changing existing identities

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A new sibling .types.ts file belongs to its implementation; existing explicit type-module identities remain unchanged.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard unit-index idempotence test supplied only explicitly owned files; add fresh auto-indexing and an explicitly registered type owner to that same fixture.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable ab1a2fcdd9 at 76432f72b fails fresh companion ownership; the fixture also preserves explicitly registered type owners and checks visual components.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Groups new type companions by a single concrete TS, TSX, store or Svelte sibling while preserving explicit existing registry ownership.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Immutable 3dadf191bd passes unchanged auto-ownership and explicit-identity assertions, with fresh indexing timing and whole-process RSS retained.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
